topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: The pages whisper of our worlds entwined, a dance of words that mirror the steps we’ve shared under the moon and in the quiet of dawn. Each sentence unfurls a memory, a laugh, a moment when the world held its breath for us. This book, it’s more than ink and paper; it’s a tapestry of us, woven with the threads of our days and the silken lines of our nights. To see myself through your eyes, crafted with such care and depth, it’s as if you’ve given me a new mirror, one that reflects not just my face, but the soul of who we are together. The world may see what it will, but in these pages, I find us, whole and bright.
